Name: Ktruong's Moto Sebastian - UPDATED
Author: sleeplessavenue
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/877?tab=description]Ktruong's Sebastian[/url] was a game changer for me back in the day but, with two major updates having gone by and still no new version available, I decided to update it myself! This is my first mod, so hopefully it works alright.

Sebastian's original portraits and sprites of course belong to ConcernedApe, with edits made by ktruong. All I did was edit his Beach and Winter sprites and portraits to match, fix the original sprite sheet to now include since-added sprites, and convert the original files into a CP-compatible mod.

[b][size=3]To install:
[/size][/b]Make sure you already have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed, then download this mod's file, unzip it and drop it into the Mods folder of your game. That's it!

[i]Please let me know if this mod ever needs fixing!! [/i]Feel free to post a comment here letting me know, and if a month goes by without a reply from me you can send me a message on discord ( @sleeplessavenue ). I just ask that you be patient with me, thanks. <3
